title: Kovalam - Best Beaches, Things to Do & Travel Guide | Kerala Tourism
content:
Kovalam - The Jewel of Kerala’s Coastline

Kovalam, a small coastal town in Kerala, is one of the most popular beach destinations in India. Known for its golden sand beaches, swaying palm trees, and calming waves, Kovalam is often called the “Paradise of the South.” Whether you are looking for relaxation, adventure, or cultural experiences, Kovalam has something for every traveler.

Why Kovalam Should Be on Your Travel List 

  • Beautiful Beaches - Kovalam is famous for its crescent-shaped beaches like Lighthouse Beach, Hawa Beach, and Samudra Beach. Each beach has its own charm, from lively atmospheres to peaceful retreats.
  • Water Sports & Adventure - Visitors can enjoy activities like surfing, parasailing, and swimming, making it a perfect destination for thrill-seekers.
  • Ayurvedic Therapy & Wellness - Kovalam is also a hub for Ayurvedic massages and wellness treatments. Many resorts and spas offer authentic Ayurvedic therapies that help rejuvenate the body and mind.
  • Cultural Experiences - From traditional Kathakali dance performances to exploring Kerala’s local markets, Kovalam offers a glimpse of rich culture and heritage.
  • Perfect Getaway - Located just 16 km from Thiruvananthapuram (Trivandrum), Kovalam is easy to reach and perfect for a short beach vacation.
  • Vizhinjam Marine Aquarium: A small but fascinating aquarium with rare marine life and a special technique of “image projection through optical fiber”.
  • Halcyon Castle: Built in 1932, this palace once served as the summer retreat of the royal family of Travancore.

Top Tourist Places in Tamil Nadu

  • Lighthouse Beach : The most famous of Kovalam's beaches, known for its iconic Vizhinjam Lighthouse.
  • Hawah Beach (Eve's Beach): A peaceful spot known for stunning sunsets and gentle waves.
  • Samudra Beach: A secluded and picturesque beach, less crowded than Lighthouse or Hawah Beach.
  • Artificial Offshore Coral Reef: An underwater attraction and a popular spot for surfing, created to protect the coastline.
  • Vellayani Lake: A beautiful freshwater lake, popular for boating and serene views, especially during the Onam festival boat race.
  • Vizhinjam Rock Cut Cave Temple: A historic 8th-century rock-cut temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, showcasing ancient sculptures.

Best Time to Visit Kovalam

The best time to visit Kovalam is from September to March, when the weather is pleasant and ideal for beach activities. Monsoons (June to August) are perfect for Ayurvedic treatments, as the season is considered best for body detox and healing therapies.

Things to Do in Kovalam

  • Relax at Lighthouse Beach and enjoy the panoramic view from the top of the lighthouse.
  • Take a peaceful stroll at Samudra Beach.
  • Explore Vellayani Lake and enjoy a boat ride.
  • Experience authentic Kerala seafood.
  • Watch the mesmerizing sunset over the Arabian Sea.

How to Reach Kovalam

  • By Air - The nearest airport is Trivandrum International Airport (15 km away).
  • By Rail - Trivandrum Central Railway Station is the closest major railhead./
  • By Road - Kovalam is well connected by buses and taxis from Trivandrum and other cities in Kerala.
excerpt: Kovalam, the jewel of Kerala’s coastline, is famous for its golden beaches, Ayurvedic therapies, and exciting water sports. From Lighthouse Beach to Samudra Beach, Kovalam offers the perfect blend of relaxation and adventure. Plan your Kovalam trip to experience Kerala’s top beach destination and unforgettable sunsets.
